actions.title: Go back
actions.description: Use ordinary Back navigation without app-specific source-control interception.

actions.title: Go forward
actions.description: Use ordinary Forward navigation without app-specific source-control interception.

actions.title: Hold open App Switcher
actions.description: Open the native macOS App Switcher, keep it available for selection while held, and commit the highlighted app on release.

actions.title: Play next track
actions.description: Advance to the next track through the standard macOS media-key route.

actions.title: Play or pause current media
actions.description: Toggle playback through the standard macOS media-key route.

actions.title: Play previous track
actions.description: Return to the previous track through the standard macOS media-key route.

actions.title: Scroll horizontally left
actions.description: Move horizontally to the left, repeating naturally while the physical trigger remains held.

actions.title: Scroll horizontally right
actions.description: Move horizontally to the right, repeating naturally while the physical trigger remains held.

actions.title: Toggle VoiceInk++ speech-to-text
actions.description: Toggle VoiceInk++ using its existing Control-Option-Shift shortcut.

actions.title: VS Code: go to next change
actions.description: Move down to the next source-control change through the existing Better Git F13 keybinding.

actions.title: VS Code: go to previous change
actions.description: Move up to the previous source-control change through the existing Better Git F17 keybinding.

actions.title: VS Code: stage and go to next change
actions.description: Stage the current changed file and advance through the existing Better Git F18 keybinding.
